provided_skills.name: glm-basics
provided_skills.description: Basic usage of the General Lake Model (GLM) for lake temperature simulation. Use when you need to run GLM, understand input files, or modify configuration parameters.

provided_skills.name: glm-calibration
provided_skills.description: Calibrate GLM parameters for water temperature simulation. Use when you need to adjust model parameters to minimize RMSE between simulated and observed temperatures.

provided_skills.name: glm-output
provided_skills.description: Read and process GLM output files. Use when you need to extract temperature data from NetCDF output, convert depth coordinates, or calculate RMSE against observations.
